evidence_candidates.excerpt: KISTI reported that an earlier procurement for its sixth national supercomputer failed after generative-AI demand increased GPU demand and prices. The revised plan increased the budget by 53 percent, extended the schedule, and targeted service in the first half of 2026.
evidence_candidates.statement_supported: Public supercomputing plans are being reshaped by AI and data-infrastructure demand while funding, procurement and component-supply constraints alter deployment paths.
